item.description: Tohoku Cherry Blossoms Late April Early May: The Best Spots for Japan’s Most Spectacular Hanami Meta description: Discover the best Tohoku cherry blossoms in late April and early May — from castle moats to riverside tunnels. Insider timing tips, regional food, and practical advice for Japan’s northern spring. Introduction: Why Tohoku Is Japan’s Best-Kept Cherry Blossom Secret If you’ve ever dreamed of standing beneath a canopy of cherry blossoms without fighting through crowds of thousands, Tohoku is where that dream comes true.
